# Clementine Ainslie

## Overview

- **Age:** 25  <sub>[v5 c21 P17](../source/v05-c21.md#nw-v05-c21-p0017)</sub>
- **Gender:** female  <sub>[v5 c2 P63](../source/v05-c02.md#nw-v05-c02-p0063)</sub>
- **Origin:** Glen St. Agnes  <sub>[v5 c13 P9](../source/v05-c13.md#nw-v05-c13-p0009)</sub>
- **Role:** Music teacher  <sub>[v5 c2 P66](../source/v05-c02.md#nw-v05-c02-p0066), [v5 c4 P50](../source/v05-c04.md#nw-v05-c04-p0050)</sub>

## Appearance

Clementine is an exceptionally attractive young woman who is imposing in height, light-complexioned, and possesses a serene, celestial blue-eyed countenance with a lofty pale brow and pink cheeks. Her golden hair, which resembles the color of fresh molasses taffy, is fastened in smooth, tight braids. She has a gentle, unhurried smile and wears remarkably pretty clothes.

_Sources: [v5 c2 P63](../source/v05-c02.md#nw-v05-c02-p0063), [v5 c4 P52](../source/v05-c04.md#nw-v05-c04-p0052), [v5 c13 P7](../source/v05-c13.md#nw-v05-c13-p0007), [v5 c13 P8](../source/v05-c13.md#nw-v05-c13-p0008), [v5 c14 P39](../source/v05-c14.md#nw-v05-c14-p0039), [v5 c20 P9](../source/v05-c20.md#nw-v05-c20-p0009)_

## Personality

Clementine is widely regarded as a sweet, compassionate, and gracious woman whose gentle demeanor endears her to others without ever seeming haughty. She possesses a joyful sense of wonder toward life that retains a youthful quality in her gaze and aura. Although capable of deep love and patience, she exercises great restraint and feels bound to respect her solemn promises.

_Sources: [v5 c4 P52](../source/v05-c04.md#nw-v05-c04-p0052), [v5 c12 P5](../source/v05-c12.md#nw-v05-c12-p0005), [v5 c13 P8](../source/v05-c13.md#nw-v05-c13-p0008), [v5 c13 P9](../source/v05-c13.md#nw-v05-c13-p0009), [v5 c17 P81](../source/v05-c17.md#nw-v05-c17-p0081)_

## History

Clementine grew up in a strict Episcopalian household in Glen St. Agnes alongside her older sister Harriet. When she was seventeen, her fiancé Martin Crawford drowned in a shipwreck, an event that stripped away her girlhood. Following her mother's death when Clementine turned twenty-five, she swore a solemn oath over a Bible with Harriet never to marry and to live together always. Clementine later began offering music lessons to local children simply because it pleased her, despite her family's comfortable wealth. After Minister John Ashdown developed a deep romantic affection for her and proposed, Clementine realized she loved him in return, but she reluctantly asked for time to think before sending a formal written refusal to uphold her oath. She subsequently spent two months away visiting Portmaris before returning to Glen St. Agnes, where John's young daughter Ida Ashdown later approached her to ask her to marry her father.

_Sources: [v5 c2 P66](../source/v05-c02.md#nw-v05-c02-p0066), [v5 c4 P50](../source/v05-c04.md#nw-v05-c04-p0050), [v5 c13 P0](../source/v05-c13.md#nw-v05-c13-p0000), [v5 c13 P9](../source/v05-c13.md#nw-v05-c13-p0009), [v5 c21 P15](../source/v05-c21.md#nw-v05-c21-p0015), [v5 c21 P17](../source/v05-c21.md#nw-v05-c21-p0017), [v5 c21 P24](../source/v05-c21.md#nw-v05-c21-p0024), [v5 c21 P30](../source/v05-c21.md#nw-v05-c21-p0030), [v5 c22 P41](../source/v05-c22.md#nw-v05-c22-p0041), [v5 c26 P15](../source/v05-c26.md#nw-v05-c26-p0015), [v5 c34 P6](../source/v05-c34.md#nw-v05-c34-p0006), [v5 c34 P13](../source/v05-c34.md#nw-v05-c34-p0013)_
